name: 05060 · Randolph, VT
findings: ZIP 05060 (Randolph) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05060 (Randolph) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 05060 (Randolph) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 69% of all organizations here have no identified type.
